title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 As far as the available capacity in these jails is concerned, the highest capacity for keeping the prisoners was available in West Bengal (1392) followed by Tamil Nadu (685), Orissa (513), Uttar Pradesh (470), Assam (368), Maharashtra (246), Kerala (150) and Karnataka (111) inmates respectively in their state special jails. Provision for exclusive female capacity for keeping female prisoners in these special jails was also available in Tamil Nadu (65), Orissa (30), Karnataka (12), Assam (8) and Maharashtra (3).
